title: The Riemann Hypothesis via Multiplicity Chains: An Exposition and Lean 4 Companion to the Alpöge–Claude Proof
description: An expository companion and modular five-file Lean 4 walkthrough spine (src/Readable/, 15 audited theorems) paired with the byte-for-byte unmodified upstream compact Lean 4 formalization of Levent Alpöge and Claude's proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis for Dirichlet L-functions (grh-compact, lsernau/grh-lean commit 72fead1, Apache 2.0). Includes complete prose proofs of the Stepanov finite-field prototype, Landau/Cauchy-moment analytic endgame, product-formula volume pinch, Behrend sphere, exact prime-sum cancellation, assembly of GRH from Theorems A–C, and exact CM prime-sum identity; mechanism sketches for admissible-data existence and CM jet divisibility; architectural summaries of Theorems A–C anchored to compiled Lean declarations; executable Python verification checks; and a Lean v4.35.0 standard-axiom audit.
